meta.question: Checking whether two bullet-resist reducers add up, take only the stronger one, or each remove a share of what is left (and whether they do anything on an enemy with no bullet resist).
meta.purpose: decides whether the second reducer is worth its souls: 10 builds hold Bullet Resist Shredder together with Hunter's Aura or Crippling Headshot, and 22 builds hold 2+ reducers of any kind
meta.mechanics: each reducer applies its own debuff (items.json: BulletArmorReduction on Bullet Resist Shredder -10 and Hunter's Aura -10, doubled with one enemy hero near = -20 (SingleTargetPlayerMultiplier 2); BulletResistReduction on Crippling Headshot -16 with DiminishingMultiplier 0.5). The combining rule and whether the number is percentage points or a share of the target's resist are engine-side (UNRESOLVED). The target gets 30 percent bullet resist from Bullet Resilience (verified 34.8 -> 24.4 per bullet); two arms use 0 percent
meta.feeds: novel hypothesis N02 (resist reducer stacking); extends duo_D1_shred_formula with the cross-family pair and the diminishing multiplier
meta.prediction_table: ratio of mean damage per bullet to the matching no-reducer arm, for resist 30 percent unless the label ends _0. N_30: ADD 1.000 | ADD with 2nd source x0.5 1.000 | MAX 1.000 | FRACTION-OF-RESIST 1.000 || BRS_30: ADD 1.143 | ADD with 2nd source x0.5 1.143 | MAX 1.143 | FRACTION-OF-RESIST 1.043 || HA_30: ADD 1.286 | ADD with 2nd source x0.5 1.286 | MAX 1.286 | FRACTION-OF-RESIST 1.086 || BRS_HA_30: ADD 1.429 | ADD with 2nd source x0.5 1.357 | MAX 1.286 | FRACTION-OF-RESIST 1.120 || Nh_30: ADD 1.000 | ADD with 2nd source x0.5 1.000 | MAX 1.000 | FRACTION-OF-RESIST 1.000 || CH_30: ADD 1.229 | ADD with 2nd source x0.5 1.229 | MAX 1.229 | FRACTION-OF-RESIST 1.069 || BRS_CH_30: ADD 1.371 | ADD with 2nd source x0.5 1.300 | MAX 1.229 | FRACTION-OF-RESIST 1.105 || N_0: ADD 1.000 | ADD with 2nd source x0.5 1.000 | MAX 1.000 | FRACTION-OF-RESIST 1.000 || BRS_HA_0: ADD 1.300 | ADD with 2nd source x0.5 1.250 | MAX 1.200 | FRACTION-OF-RESIST 1.000
meta.prediction_reading: ADD column = reductions are percentage points and add; ADD with 2nd source x0.5 = the DiminishingMultiplier halves every later source; MAX = only the strongest applies; FRACTION = each takes that share of the remaining resist (then BRS_HA_0 must be 1.00: nothing to remove). If ADD or ADD-with-x0.5 holds on an enemy with 0 resist, the ratio exceeds 1 (negative resist amplifies)
meta.decision_rule: match each arm to the nearest column (within 0.02). ADD: both reducers are worth their price, model credits the sum. MAX or ADD with x0.5: the second reducer is worth less than half in the builds in changes_builds, builds owner replaces it. FRACTION: reducers matter only against high-resist enemies, so value them by target resist in the model. No column within 0.02: INSUFFICIENT, report the three ratios
meta.changes_builds: bebop, bebop_support, haze_assassin, yamato_brawler, geist, warden, abrams_melee, holliday, shiv_gun, ivy_carry
meta.unresolved_if: N_30 vs N_30_end per-bullet damage differ by more than 3 percent (drift), or Nh_30 is not about 1.65 times N_30 (headshots not registering): head arms INVALID; BRS arms need the Sleep Dagger hit to land (dmg row for ability 1 present)
meta.selection_reason: independent theorycraft: reducers are bought in 22 builds, the combining rule is not in the data, and the data hints at three different rules (two property names, a DiminishingMultiplier on one item)
meta.alternative_reason: the same sequence with Sleep Dagger cast in every arm so the only difference is the items
meta.rotation: Sleep Dagger once, 0.6 s later 3 s of gun fire at 350u, 100 percent accuracy (body only; head arms use all-head), arms bracketed by the no-reducer control and run in reverse in the second half
meta.cond_activations: Bullet Resist Shredder (needs the dagger hit), Hunter's Aura (passive), Crippling Headshot (needs headshots)
meta.player_what: Two bullet shreds on one target
meta.result_says: WORKS if the two-reducer arms deal clearly more per bullet than the best single reducer arm (ADD or FRACTION column); DOES NOT WORK if they equal the best single arm (MAX)
